page.title: Page
page.loadError: The lines saved in this browser could not be loaded.
page.lineMerged: Line joined to the one above

dnd.instructions: To move a line, press space or Enter, use the up and down arrows, then press space or Enter again to drop it. Escape cancels.

priority.title: By priority
priority.intro: Your active lines, most important first: it counts their flags' weights, whether their schedule starts within the hour and how soon they expire. Click a line to go to it on the page.
priority.empty: No active lines. A line becomes active when you give it a flag, for example #health.
priority.goTo: Go to the line on the page

journal.title: Gratitude journal
journal.empty: No completed entries yet. Tick a gratitude line and write your notes to see it here.
journal.pending_one: You have {{count}} pending entry on the page.
journal.pending_other: You have {{count}} pending entries on the page.

flags.title: Flags
flags.intro: Flags rank your lines by importance. Type #name in a line to assign one. The weights of each group of siblings must add up to 100.
flags.loadError: The flags saved in this browser could not be read.
flags.drift: The weights of some groups no longer add up to 100 (changes made on another device, or a deletion). Priority shares them out proportionally, but you should fix them.
flags.driftGroup: This group does not add up to 100.
flags.mustSum: The weights must add up to {{total}} to save.
flags.weightInvalid: Each weight must be a number from 0 to 100.
flags.name: Name
flags.system: System flag: its name cannot be changed.
flags.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Lines keep the mark, but it will no longer be recognized.
flags.confirmDeleteTree: Delete “{{name}}” and all its subflags? Lines keep the marks, but they will no longer be recognized.

nameProblem.taken: There is already a flag with that name in this group.

archived.title: Archived
archived.intro: Archived lines leave the page. Restoring one puts it back at the end of the page.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.
auth.offlineFirstSignIn: You are offline. The first sign-in needs a connection; after that the app works without one.

confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.help: We sent you a code by email. Enter it here to activate the account.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.codeSent: If the email exists, we sent you a code.

info.confirmed: Account confirmed. You can sign in now.
info.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.

errors.userExists: An account with that email already exists.
errors.notConfirmed: The account is not confirmed yet.
errors.expiredCode: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.weakPassword: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: You are offline. Try again when you are back online.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutPending_one: You have {{count}} change not uploaded to the cloud. If you sign out now, it will be lost.
settings.signOutPending_other: You have {{count}} changes not uploaded to the cloud. If you sign out now, they will be lost.
settings.signOutOffline: You are offline: connect and try again to upload them before signing out.
settings.gratitudeHint: Adds a gratitude line at the top of the page on this schedule. This setting is for this browser.

tick.habit: Add a day to the streak (line {{n}}): {{count}}

panel.title: Line details
panel.cronHint: minute hour day month weekday, for example 0 8 * * 1-5
panel.cronInvalid: The cron expression is not valid.
panel.habitFormed: You reached the target streak. Mark the habit as formed?

pwa.newVersion: A new version of bacuy-y is available.
pwa.installHint: Installed, bacuy-y opens in its own window, from the desktop or the home screen, and works offline.
pwa.installLater: You can install it later from the browser menu:
pwa.installed: bacuy-y is already installed on this device.
pwa.howDesktop: Computer (Chrome or Edge): the install icon in the address bar.
pwa.howAndroid: Android (Chrome): ⋮ menu → “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.howIos: iPhone or iPad (Safari): Share button → “Add to Home Screen”.

completed.title: Completed
completed.intro: Completed tasks leave the page. Unticking one puts it back where it was.
completed.reopen: Untick and put back on the page
completed.reopenLine: Untick “{{title}}” and put it back on the page

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.intro: Lines off the page for now: the ones you hid and repetitive tasks done for this time. They come back to their place on their own.

filter.hint: A flag includes its subflags. With several, lines with any of them are shown.
filter.emptyPlaceholder: Nothing with this filter. Type here to add.
